_comment: M13g settings-loader section (hand-pinned ground truth, NOT --record; same route as action_tree.json). TacticalAISettings.Load reads ONLY the named fields via Json.Get (TryGetValue) and never enumerates unknown keys, so a stale 'deployment' field left over in old PlayerPrefs saves from the removed deployment switch is silently ignored: no throw, no warning, no state change. Cases 1-2 pin the two historical values ('secret', 'open'); case 3 adds an unknown extra key on top. loaded_ok pins the absence of any exception (the section catches it explicitly). modeOverride absent in ToJson proves the new serialization writes no deployment field any more. Presentation/settings-only: planning behaviour and all Canon vectors are untouched, there is no Python sim twin. M13h (Thomas 28.10): DefaultExplainLevel changed post_hoc->none; case 3 (no explicit explain in save) now defaults to none, its pins updated accordingly.
